channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran warns Ukraine of retaliation after deadly Caspian Sea strike
item.description: Abbas Araghchi says the Ukrainian attack on the Iranian vessel in the Caspian Sea 'cannot go unanswered'.

item.title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
item.description: Kyiv says Russian strikes killed six, including a child at a supermarket, as Moscow says Ukrainian strikes killed four.

item.title: Ebola infections in DR Congo surge to 3,200, with 1,405 deaths
item.description: Cases have surged by 1,000 in just 10 days as outbreak continues to spread across five provinces.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran halts retaliatory strikes after pause in US attacks
item.description: The US has paused its two-week bombing campaign against Iran, prompting Tehran to suspend its retaliatory attacks.

item.title: Khamenei ties US-Iran peace deal to Israel ending attacks on Lebanon
item.description: Iran's supreme leader calls for 'absolute, unconditional termination' of Israel's attacks on Lebanon.

item.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect shot and killed during police operation
item.description: Police say Abdul Ballout was shot and killed after he rushed at officers with a knife in a western borough of Berlin.

item.title: Israeli settlers set fire to mosques, cars and farm land in West Bank, Palestinians say
item.description: The latest attacks come two days after a clash between settlers and Palestinians near the village of Tal, which left four Palestinians and two Israelis dead.

item.title: Ten killed in Russian attack on drone exhibition near Kyiv
item.description: The event, attended by prominent members of the Ukrainian defence industry, was hit by ballistic missiles in the middle of the day.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis claim missile attack on Saudi Arabia
item.description: US military says it disabled a tanker that was attempting to evade the American blockade on Iranian ports.
